verdict.rationale: GitCafe is a Git forge that hosts an MCP server and hands issues to coding agents, so auditing agent activity is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no audit log or session record for agent actions. Tokens and MCP connections let tools act "as you", and commit history and blame show who changed code, but these are adjacent attribution and history features, not an audit of agent sessions.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can audit AI agent sessions and actions attributed to the user who triggered them
